arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE high-resolution hand-painted cartoon game sprite on a truly transparent RGBA background. Input 1 is the authoritative original pixel sprite: preserve its object count, view angle, orientation and overall silhouette, faithfully translating it into clean smooth illustrated artwork. Input 2 is a STYLE reference only for bold black outlines, clean highlights and simple dimensional shading. Never copy its aircraft design, colors or direction. No background, ground, drop shadow, letters, labels or comparison panels. Keep the entire isolated sprite visible with transparent margin.
Subject: compact charcoal-black aircraft nose pointing LEFT and tail RIGHT, one broad gray-highlighted wing angled to upper right, near wing at lower left, slim yellow underside trim and yellow wing/tail tips as in source. Preserve the extremely dark charcoal identity with enough subtle slate highlights for shape, not a bright silver or blue plane. No additional passengers, no text, no scenery.
